title: COUNTROWS of a fact table filtered to nothing is BLANK, not 0

source.quote: If the table has no rows, COUNTROWS returns BLANK
source.supports: COUNTROWS of a table with no rows is BLANK, not 0

derivation: Green is Scooter (4), which exists in Product but has no Sales rows. Sales filtered by it is empty: BLANK.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: the only value is BLANK.
